purpose: Provenance and candidates, not product authority

systems.lesson: Staged turns, bounded iterations, persistent sessions and learned skills.
systems.disposition: Study runtime boundaries or use as a worker. Do not replace canonical Core. Exact repository internals/version claims in Muse were not re-audited for this pack.

systems.lesson: Separate memory/skill tracks and readable memory files.
systems.disposition: Candidate portable skill archive and retrieval adapter. Host synthesis is not zero-cost or automatically correct merely because the service makes no LLM calls.

systems.lesson: Retrieve before proposing ADD/UPDATE/DELETE rather than append contradictory facts.
systems.disposition: Candidate extraction design. Core validates promotion and keeps source evidence. LLM extraction is not authoritative state.

systems.lesson: Reasoned user representations beyond individual facts.
systems.disposition: Candidate hypothesis subsystem only. Inferred user models remain editable hypotheses, never constitution or permission.

systems.lesson: Separation of model, engine, agents, tools/memory and learning, with explicit evaluation.
systems.disposition: Candidate local-worker/evaluation patterns. Do not conflate with Arcus, OpenClaw or unrelated projects sharing the name.

systems.lesson: Gateway, channels and device companion pattern.
systems.disposition: Candidate executor/gateway adapter. Distinct from Arcus. No channel support or safety guarantees are presumed from the report alone.

systems.lesson: One identity across desktop, watch, phone and messaging.
systems.disposition: Interface inspiration. Report labels internals undisclosed. Not a reproducible local-model or security recipe.

systems.lesson: Capture, transcribe, normalize, retrieve and act.
systems.disposition: Candidate ingestion discipline, not a mandate to record everything. Fletcher mechanics are described as unverified; do not invent its ranking algorithm.

systems.lesson: Business data read, interpret, brief and propose operations through tools.
systems.disposition: Candidate FBA read-only workflow. Existence of RevenueCat/Meta/Playwright does not prove the creator harness. Revenue divided by ad spend alone is not necessarily attributed ROAS.

systems.lesson: Structured browser observation before screenshot fallback.
systems.disposition: Candidate browser executor. Tool annotations are hints, not authorization. UI actions must revalidate origin, target and observed result.

systems.lesson: Telephony as a separately metered and permissioned transport.
systems.disposition: Candidate calling adapter only after a concrete approved use case. No current price/latency commitment is imported.

systems.lesson: Headless coding-agent host behind a browser face, streaming and reconnect/session concerns.
systems.disposition: Candidate worker integration. Inheriting local MCP servers is a risk, not blanket authorization. Do not run a coding agent with owner credentials as Core.

systems.lesson: Voice and text continuity, streaming TTS, redaction and interruption bookkeeping.
systems.disposition: Candidate voice adapter. Retain generated, spoken and interrupted segments separately, without rewriting action history.

systems.lesson: UI-resolved confirmation instead of model-supplied confirmed=true.
systems.disposition: Exact repo locator not supplied in the source excerpt. Treat implementation detail as report-attributed. JARVIS uses per-action pending records, not a single global confirmation.

systems.lesson: Realtime media transport and interruption across mobile/web.
systems.disposition: Candidate voice transport. The two reports describe different cascade/native-audio wiring, so the exact tutorial recipe remains unresolved.

systems.lesson: Voice tools dispatch to workflow webhooks.
systems.disposition: Candidate long-tail connector pattern. Voice, workflow orchestration and canonical memory remain separate. No n8n install is required by V4.

systems.lesson: Shared task store with a messaging entrypoint and multiple workers.
systems.disposition: Candidate UI/work coordination. Report says source is paywalled. Do not present reconstructed integration code as verified.

systems.lesson: Operator loop: purpose, tools, memory, authority and feedback.
systems.disposition: Framing only. Reports disclose no reproducible implementation. V4 definitions derive authority from own accepted rules, not a creator claim.

systems.lesson: Local wake, speech recognition and speech synthesis as separate privacy stages.
systems.disposition: Candidate local tier. Local capture does not make later cloud reasoning or cloud TTS local.

systems.lesson: Local document retrieval with source references and optional cloud answer generation.
systems.disposition: Candidate source retrieval pattern. A retrieval result is evidence content, not permission or a remembered fact.

verifiedToolingSources.scope: SKILL.md progressive disclosure and .agents/skills lookup, not arbitrary plugin availability
TOML role name, description and developer_instructions, model optional
Sandbox and environment keys; retired untrusted approval policy avoided; validate installed host before merge
Untrusted candidate execution separated from privileged workflows
General key lifecycle principles, not certification of custom V5 protocol
